label: Bible Study
prompt: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the _____ of the law.
verse: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
note: Love never harms a neighbour — which is why it fulfils the whole law.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For ye are all the _____ of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verse: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
note: Faith is the family resemblance: Paul says all who believe are children of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a _____ by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verse: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
note: At Gibeon, God appeared to young Solomon in a dream with a blank check: 'Ask what I shall give thee.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And let us consider one another to _____ unto love and to good works:
verse: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
note: The one good kind of provoking — church as a place where people stir each other up to love and good works.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having _____ ears;
verse: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
note: 'Itching ears' — audiences who shop for teachers that scratch where it itches. Paul's forecast for Timothy.
